overview: You took the king off the wall and did not give the ground a speech. Sunday's margin still said leave it. You stopped for dinner. The glass was not on the board.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the descent as far as the ground, and put the pen down.

assets.name: Richard II
assets.disposition: Brought the king off the wall, short of a speech

summary: Brought the king off the wall, short of a speech
